jobs.title: Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
Do you have hands-on experience executing technical implementations, ERP system configurations, and data mapping in a client-facing environment, with fluent professional proficiency in both German and English?

Do you possess proven expertise in EDI and supply chain ecosystems, along with a track record of independently managing complex client integrations, resolving technical change events, and coordinating with third-party partners?

Great! Then please read on, because we have a great job for you!

The position is to be filled in the home office in Germany (Düsseldorf/Dortmund area is preferred).

We are searching for an l Implementation Consultant to join our client's team and lead post-sale technical implementations, system configurations, and data mapping for complex supply chain solutions. Operating remotely in Germany (preferably near the Düsseldorf or Dortmund area), you will serve as a key technical liaison - analyzing client operational needs, executing ERP integrations, and resolving ongoing customer change events.

Key responsibilities:

Performing post-sale initial technical implementation of technology products
Executing installation, upgrades, testing, and system configuration to complete implementation projects
Consulting with clients to analyze and verify operational needs and to understand their business objectives and goals
Tracking the progress of implementation projects, ensuring deadlines are met and scheduling issues are resolved
Keeping customers and other stakeholders informed of project progress
Applying, testing, and reconfiguring data rules to produce the required results
Working under moderate supervision, with some latitude for independent judgment
Facilitating problem research, isolation, diagnosis, resolution, and follow-up for customer change events
Contributing to developing standardized solutions for customers
Escalating events appropriately when they fall outside your scope
Owning support instances that require partner involvement, acting as the escalation point between the client and partner network
Working directly with third parties, consultants, VARs, and adapter or application providers
Taking on complex work of high importance to the organization
Maintaining deep industry-specific business knowledge, staying current with emerging products and technical updates

You should have the following requirements for the Implementation Consultant role:

A bachelor's degree with various years of related experience or equivalent practical experience
Fluent German and English
ERP knowledge, good communicator, problem solver
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several projects concurrently
The ability to apply, test, and reconfigure data rules to produce the intended result
Demonstrated ability to work with minimal supervision while taking initiative and setting priorities in a demanding, fast-paced environment
Strong relationship-building skills, including over the phone
Demonstrated organization and prioritisation skills, with the ability to handle multiple concurrent activities

Nice to have:

Demonstrated organization and prioritization skills, with the ability to handle multiple concurrent activities •
Exposure to third parties, consultants, VARs, or adapter and application providers
Familiarity with XML
Experience with text editing and data mapping tools, and in-depth knowledge of mapping tool functionality
Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills
A balanced mix of skills: driver and facilitator, tactical leader and doer

What Our Client Offers:

Impact & High Growth:
You won't just follow playbook processes; you'll help build and refine them.
Clear Career Progression
: Growth path opportunities
High-Visibility & Diverse Projects
: Dynamic portfolio ranging from high-impact ERP integrations to agile e-invoicing implementations across European retail giants.
Autonomy & Ownership:
High degree of freedom to take initiative, solve complex challenges, and directly shape our expanding European footprint.
Culture & team:
Be part of a fast-growing team at SPS with an energetic culture packed with team socials, company events, and plenty of reasons to celebrate our wins together.

jobs.title: Logistics Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
Gellert Global Group consists of many of the leading North American food importing companies (Atalanta Corporation, Camerican International, Finica, GGG Manufacturing) and has been importing food products for over 100 years. The combined revenues of GGG exceed $1.7 billion. GGG companies provide strength in sourcing, insurance, finance, logistics, food safety, and information technology, and supply the needs of retailers, distributors, food service chains, hotels, cruise lines, and food manufacturers alike.

We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-driven Logistics Analyst to support our Import Compliance function. This role is critical to ensuring our organization meets all U.S. Customs and Partner Government Agency requirements while maintaining seamless, on-time product flow.

As a key member of the Import Compliance team, you will evaluate the accuracy of import entries, lead classification initiatives, investigate issues, and deliver actionable insights that enhance operational integrity. You will collaborate closely with warehouses, Supply Chain, Finance, Sales Support, and external partners to support compliant, efficient, and uninterrupted operations.

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

Support CTPAT compliance across facilities, partners, and processes, including procedural, physical, and personnel security requirements.

Maintain and administer risk assessments, Minimum Security Criteria (MSC), and warehouse security expectations.

Ensure adherence to U.S. import laws and internal compliance programs.

Lead a comprehensive HTS classification project and manage ongoing system accuracy for HTS and duty updates.

Review, verify, and validate partner data against Customs compliance requirements.

Maintain accurate entry packets—including valuation details, country-of-origin declarations, and all required documentation—in accordance with SOPs.

Investigate compliance discrepancies, identify root causes, and support implementation of corrective actions.

Monitor regulatory updates and compliance bulletins, escalating significant changes to leadership.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure on-time delivery and alignment with compliance standards.

Improve, automate, and simplify import procedures to strengthen audit readiness and support scalable, compliant growth.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Logistics, Business, or a related field, preferred

Experience with import compliance programs, HTS classification, CTPAT, or other trade compliance frameworks, preferred

5–7 years of experience in logistics, imports, international transportation, or supply chain operations, required

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data cleaning, data validation).

Excellent analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills.

Proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

Strong prioritization skills with the ability to pivot as needs change.

High level of professionalism, positive attitude, and strong work ethic.

Salary:
$70,000 - $80,000 annually plus bonus

Our company will be relocating to a new corporate headquarters in Madison, NJ in Q4 of 2026. Candidates should be comfortable with this upcoming change in location.

Our Benefits:

We care about your total well-being and will support you with the following, subject to your location and role.

Health:
Medical, dental and vision insurance, Company-paid life, accident and long-term disability insurance, flexible spending accounts

Wealth:
Competitive pay, annual bonus opportunity, matching 401(k) with immediate vesting upon enrollment, generous employee referral program

Happiness:

Professional Growth:
Online training courses, virtual and classroom development experiences, education assistance program

Work-Life Balance:
Paid-time off, parental leave, flexible work schedules (subject to your location and role)

Team Building:
Employee engagement and recognition programs, wellness, philanthropic and DE&I initiatives, Company-sponsored celebrations, and team-building events

The Gellert Global Group of companies is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, ethnic or national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, pregnancy, leave status, disability, veteran status, genetic information and/or any other characteristic or status protected by national, federal, state, or local law. Gellert Global Group is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Accordingly, if reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of the position, and/or to receive all other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact hr@gellertglobalgroup.com.
